name: @playform/ets-lib-dsh-pack
description: The PACKS: the pure, dependency-light, harness-free workspace-pack library of the suggester family (@playform/ets-lib-dsh-pack) - the pack schema, the layered resolution (the user layer, the repo layer, the cycle-guarded extends chain), the strict YAML-subset parser, the merge rules, the workspace locator and the built-in pack for this monorepo. A repository with a pack gets the suggester family; a repository without one stays silent. Not a plugin bundle: no cordis patch, no loader contract, publishable on its own.
